answer: The identity then has to pass a prism challenge before it counts at all, and the result is sealed at the next kernel. Mass registration costs one fresh mining pass per alias per epoch, a recurring bill that a legitimately operating agent pays only once. Registration calls for a proof of work of 26 leading zero bits over a seed that rotates every epoch; the current seed is published as the pulse. Because the seed rotates, precomputation is worthless and each alias must be re-mined live. That is 5 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
